'''3D-4X''' was a silver-plated [[3D-4X administrative droid]].

==Biography==
3D-4X served [[Hekis Durumm Perdo Kolokk Baldikarr Thun]] on [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]]. He acted as the butler for the manufacturing administrator on the volcanic [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
Sometime before [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the escaped [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] prototype [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] arrived at Mechis III after having left behind the smoldering ruins of the [[Holowan Laboratories/Legends|Holowan Laboratories]], and convinced 3D-4X to assassinate his own master.

As of [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], long after the [[Droid Revolution]] had failed, he could be found serving the most recent owner of the droid manufacturing facilities on Mechis III, the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Tyko Thul]].
